slots.explanation: Sara receives the first pot (1 Nov 2026). Her rent is due exactly when the circle starts, and her need has the highest deadline urgency.
Omar receives the pot on 1 Dec 2026, two weeks before his 15 Dec tuition deadline — the engine places payouts just ahead of hard deadlines.
Lina receives the pot on 1 Jan 2027, giving her funds before the March wedding while deposit savings stay on schedule.
Youssef receives the pot on 1 Feb 2027. His need is flexible, so the optimiser balanced his slot against members with harder deadlines.
Karim receives the pot on 1 Mar 2027. With no deadline needs, the deterministic seed 42 tie-break placed him after Youssef.
Amina, the organiser, takes the last slot on 1 Apr 2027. She stated no urgency and deliberately yields earlier slots to members with pressing needs.
